services.name: Jet Ski Tour
services.desc: If you’re jet ski freaks like us at Sea the City, finding the best spots to put your craft can be difficult. While New Jersey is a small state, there are still tons of places you can bring your jet ski to enjoy some high-flying thrills with your watercraft. It’s just a matter of finding places that allow it, and have enough free space to make a splash. So you don’t have to, we’ve put together a list of the five best places for you to take your jet ski for tricks, speeding, and splashing around. From Sandy Hook Bay to Island Beach State Park, we have you covered. After you’ve taken a couple of lessons with us, definitely find your closest jet ski rental company and get in the water! services.desc: Private Soaks on New York Harbor - Bring Your Own Bottle - Skyline Close Enough to Touch “One of the most surreal things we’ve ever done in New York. The views are ridiculous and the crew made the whole thing feel effortless.” The hot tub boat is exactly what it sounds like. Two private hot tubs built into a cruising boat, kept at a steady 102°F, drifting past the Statue of Liberty and under the Brooklyn Bridge while you and your people soak, sip, and take in the skyline. It’s a ninety-minute cruise with a licensed captain running the boat, your own playlist on the speakers, and whatever you packed in your cooler. No shared tubs with strangers. No rushing.
